title: Graduated round diamond necklace, 18K gold
subtitle: A graduated diamond line requires every transition to be invisible — the eye should read a single increase in size and weight from the first stone to the last, not a sequence of visible steps. Each round brilliant was selected so the step from one stone to the next reads as continuation rather than increment. The engineering exists in service of the optical result.
